name: hn
title: Hacker News style community
about:
A link and discussion community built on the site comments. Members pick a username, submit links or text posts, vote, and discuss them in ranked threads.
Front page, newest, ask, show, jobs, best, past and per-site lists, with gravity ranking that updates every minute. Karma unlocks flagging, vouching and downvotes at thresholds you set.
Moderation page for the owner: flagged items, bans by user, network or domain, and a log of every action. Flagged comments turn dead and stay hidden unless a member turns on showdead.
Favorites, hidden stories, search, RSS feeds and a read-only JSON API are included. Everything works without JavaScript; with the site scripts grant, votes happen without a reload.
Pair it with the hn-classic theme, or apply the hn kit to set up pages, menus and comment settings in one step.
features: Story submission with duplicate link check
Votes, karma and gravity ranked front page
Ranked comment threads on core comments
Flags, vouches, bans and a moderation page
RSS feeds and a read-only JSON API
